purpose: Private interim 100-site comparison for eight of the twelve frozen methods

execution.retry_policy: No retry to improve a score. A proven command, version, scorer, reference, or timing error requires an append-only formal correction that replaces the full affected scope.

crawl4ai_runtime.scope: Crawl4AI execution route only; common scoring and other methods are unchanged

report.label: Interim results for 8 of 12 methods
report.alignment: Match the reference information architecture, visual system, navigation, rankings, provider pages, and attempt pages while truthfully showing 100 cases, 8/12 methods, and one popular-site task family.

invariants: The four deferred providers are unmeasured, not failed and not scored as zero.
Results from the eight-method stage cannot change the frozen membership, cases, references, scoring, or routes of the four deferred methods.
No final public twelve-method ranking may be released before all 1200 results are measured and independently reviewed.
The reviewed historical 46/100 Lexmount Global result remains separate and is not reused.
